name: never ever
description:
"never ever buy something to “support” me or anyone else

appreciate the gesture, but one of the weakest reasons to buy anything 

buy something because YOU like the idea, YOUR thesis makes sense, YOU think there is upside in a trade

as with most people (besides the most diamond handed degenerate mfs) ill sell those exact same things at one point, hopefully a lot higher

i bought them as trades because i thought this exact thought, im here to make money and have fun

as we all are"
